catalog.summary: Start and end dates with a calendar popover.

valueRules.empty: a request whose both ends are null carries null; the family speaks one word for nothing
valueRules.openEnd: { start, end: null } and { start: null, end } are values: an open end is written in the field, where the reader sees it
valueRules.reversed: an end typed before its start is invalid and stays as typed

pattern.title: Date Picker Dialog Example
pattern.rangePattern: none exists; the dialog example for the popup and the grid pattern for the grid, as date-picker
pattern.departure: the example closes on the first press and this family closes on the second press, because a range is two presses; closeOnSelect names the rest

wiring.aria-expanded: the trigger, while the popup is showing
wiring.aria-controls: the content, while the popup is showing
wiring.aria-label: the trigger, carrying both ends and the length

triggerName.chosen: the change message, with both ends in words and the length in its start, end and length slots
triggerName.why: Focus returns to the trigger when the popup closes, so the name is where the reader is told what was chosen.

draft.rule: a press that leaves the run with one end is a draft, not the value; the second press emits the whole run with reason select
draft.abandonedBy: Escape, an outside press and the trigger abandon the draft and keep the previous value
draft.openEndValue: a panel opened over { start, end: null } treats the start as an open run, and the first press closes it

length.pending: the length of the run that would exist if the pending end were chosen; with the run whole, the length of the value
length.label: the days.length or nights.length message, a plural over the count, laid over per instance through messages
length.sameDay: the same day at both ends is 1 day or 0 nights, and the band says so

position.meaning: the end the next press in the grid writes, and the field that carries data-current

calendarReceives.end: { start, end: null }, so the next press writes the end instead of restarting the run
calendarReceives.start: the whole value, so the next press restarts the run

limits.crossed: the start field takes max = min(max, end); the end field takes min = max(min, start)
limits.unit: counted in the unit count names

contiguous.grid: with an open run, the days beyond the first unavailable day after the start, and before the first one before it, are unavailable
contiguous.search: once per chosen start, each direction, up to maxLength days or 366
contiguous.typed: the predicate runs over every day of a typed run once per value change, never per cell

limits.explained: the limit part names minLength and maxLength while either is set

validity.owned: bounds, unavailable days, the order of the two ends, and the length
validity.reversed: an end before its start is invalid on the end field and on the frame; the ends are not swapped

clear.fields: the two fields do not draw their own clear; one button on the frame empties both ends with reason clear

preset.value: a DateRange, or a function returning one, resolved on press
preset.invalid: a preset whose range fails a rule still writes it and the value is invalid; the preset is not hidden

keyboard.focusTo: the cell of the current end, or today when it is empty

keyboard.staged: the calendar's view walks down first; then the panel closes and the draft is abandoned

platformNotes.altArrowDown: ChromeOS turns Alt+ArrowDown into PageDown before the browser sees it, which Angular Material records for its own input. The trigger button is therefore the guaranteed path and the chord is a shortcut, never the only way in.

dismissal.escape: through dismissable-layer, in the capture phase
dismissal.closeOnSelect: auto closes when the run becomes whole, by a second press or a preset; always closes on any press that changes the value; never closes on none

responsive.sheet: below 480px on a coarse pointer, the content takes the sheet presentation
responsive.decidedIn: the stylesheet; the DOM does not change
responsive.months: two by default; the calendar wraps the second under the first when the container is narrow

forms.angular: ControlValueAccessor writes the whole DateRange; Validator reports the family's own errors

dataAttributes.data-count: days or nights, on the root
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: on head-start or head-end: the end does not exist yet
dataAttributes.data-pending: on head-start, head-end or length: what is shown is the pending end, not the value
dataAttributes.data-placement: the side and alignment the positioner resolved

literals.--slotted-date-range-picker-sheet-inline: 100%, which the shared exemption list already holds.
